_: LatteOS's cups: what the windows are made of (Settings › Look). One source for every part: apps/common/Theme.qml (the apps), goo/lib/cup.luau (windows made with pleamar), system/pleamarwm/bin/hyprctl (the title bars), Settings (the list). A new cup is one entry here, its name translated in goo/lang/sk.plm. Keys: name, hint (said beside it), light (light, not dark), the window's colours ground…coffee, and the title bar: bar, ink.
